title: Andersen Consulting Enhances Transformation Capabilities with Bakia Consulting
summary: Andersen Consulting advances its business transformation capabilities through a Collaboration Agreement with Bakia Consulting
body_markdown:
Andersen Consulting advances its business transformation capabilities through a Collaboration Agreement with Bakia Consulting, a firm specializing in finance function transformation.


Headquartered in Paris with capabilities in Singapore and Hong Kong, Bakia Consulting has helped large corporations and financial institutions redesign their finance functions, addressing operating models, organizational structures, processes, and digital systems. The firm combines project management and change management, working alongside clients to develop solutions and sustain change. Bakia Consulting also advises on financial and non-financial management models, process optimization, and digital tools.


“Finance functions are being asked to deliver better insight, operate more efficiently, and adapt to changing business needs, often at the same time,” said Romain Dubuisson, partner at Bakia Consulting. “We work closely with clients to develop solutions that reflect their operational realities, combining established market practices with an understanding of the people and processes involved. Through our collaboration with Andersen Consulting, we can bring this way of working to a broader range of organizations.”


“Successful business transformation depends on more than introducing new technology; organizations must also rethink processes, responsibilities, and the ways teams work together,” said Mark L. Vorsatz, global chairman and CEO of Andersen. “Bakia Consulting brings a focused understanding of the operational and digital changes that can help finance teams meet evolving business demands, complementing Andersen Consulting’s capabilities in business transformation.”
